title.justification: The title of the paper is 'Parametric Scattering Networks' as mentioned at the very beginning of the document.

extractions.description: The paper investigates whether the standard construction of wavelet filters in scattering transforms is optimal. Focusing on Morlet wavelets, the authors propose to learn the scales, orientations, and aspect ratios of the filters to produce problem-specific parameterizations of the scattering transform. They show that these learned versions significantly improve performance in small-sample classification settings. The paper explores the application of these parametric scattering networks in various datasets and analyzes the computational and memory complexity.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on optimization and improved learning capabilities of scattering networks, particularly on small-sample classification and not directly on any environmental or sustainability goals.
